{{Term/Store|Raft|Rafts|Series, TLoZ, TAoL, LA, BotW, TotK, HW, HWL, HWDE|plural}} are recurring [[Item]]s and [[Object]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote= |book= A&A |page= 383{{Exp Game|TLoZ}} & 386{{Exp Game|TAoL}}}}</ref><ref>{{Cite Guide|LA Nintendo|page= 62}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Have you gone sailing with a {{Color BotW|Red|raft}}?|Armes|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|{{Big|Rafts}}<br/>Rafts with sails can move when pushed by the wind. If there's no wind blowing, a Korok frond or certain Zonai devices can fix that.|Tips and Tricks|TotK}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|{{Color HWDE|Green|Raft}}: Use this on piers to cross to the opposite shore.|Tutorial|HWDE}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Raft|Fuse|TotK}}</ref>{{Name Ref|LADX, LANS, OoA, TWW, TWWHD, ALBW, TFH, TFoE, ZA}}

==Location and Uses==
==={{TLoZ|-}}===
{{Descriptions TLoZ}}
In {{TLoZ}}, the Raft can be found in [[Level 3]]. It is used to cross bodies of water such as rivers and lakes. It can only be launched from [[dock]]s.

==={{TAoL|-}}===
{{Descriptions TAoL}}
In {{TAoL}}, the Raft can be found in the [[Island Palace]]. It is used to cross bodies of water such as rivers and lakes. It can only be launched from docks.<ref>{{Cite Manual|quote= When you get this, you can cross the sea from the dock. What's on the other side of the sea?|game= TAoL|page= 46}}</ref>

==={{LA|-}}===
In {{LA}}, [[Link]] can ride a Raft during the [[Rapids Ride]] minigame.

==={{OoA|-}}===
In {{OoA}}, if Link gives [[Rafton]] the [[Cheval Rope]], he will give Link a Raft that can be used to cross deep water. After Link is washed ashore on [[Crescent Island]], the Raft is destroyed.

==={{TWW|-}}===
{{Checklist
 |game= TWW
 |type= Objects
 |category= Objects in The Wind Waker
 |needs= 
Detailed information on the following:
* Where it can be found
* Whether it can be interacted with and if it is important to the story or a Quest
}}
In {{TWW}}, Rafts can be found floating around the [[Great Sea]] with large masts with [[skull]]s on top. Some Rafts are protected by [[Bokoblin]]s, which may have [[pot]]s, [[barrel]]s, and [[Treasure Chest]]s. Rafts can also be found around islands where [[Traveling Merchants]] are found.

==={{ALBW|-}}===
In {{ALBW}}, Rafts appear in the [[Swamp Palace]], [[Lorule Castle]], and the [[Treasure Hunter Cave]] found in the [[Southern Ruins]]. They can be used to traverse water and lava in conjunction with the [[Hookshot]].

==={{TFH|-}}===
In {{TFH}}, Rafts appear in the [[Cove of Transition]] and [[Water Temple (Tri Force Heroes)|Water Temple]] Levels of the [[Riverside]] Area. They can be used to traverse Water in conjunction with the [[Gripshot]].

==={{BotW|-}}===
In {{BotW}}, Link can use Rafts to cross bodies of [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. He must use a [[Korok Leaf]] to propel the Raft. They can be used to avoid the damage that would come by [[Swimming]] in colder bodies of Water, such as the [[River of the Dead]].

==={{TotK|-}}===
{{Stub|TotK}}

==Other Appearances==
==={{TFoE|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
In {{TFoE}}, Rafts appear in several water-based stages, including [[Spearfish Falls]], [[Firestone Lake]], and in the tar pits of [[Ganon's Lair]]. They are used to safely cross these waters and will immediately move once Link stands on one.
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{ZA|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
{{Descriptions ZA}}
In {{ZA}}, the Raft item can be found next to a pond in the [[Meadow of Skotness]] near [[Great Wimbich]]. It is used to cross the flooded passage in the [[Shrine of Water]]. Another Raft also appears in the Port Town of [[Seacoast Plain]], belonging to a seafarer. He allows [[Princess Zelda|Zelda]] to take the Raft to [[Sea Island]], provided that she pays him two [[Rupee]]s and has the [[Vial of Winds]], as the offshore wind has died down.<ref>{{Cite|If you wish to cross the sea, bring us twenty Rubies and a Vial of Wind. The offshore wind has died down, and you must bring your own breeze.|Rafter|ZA}}</ref> The same Raft can be used to return to the Port Town from Sea Island.
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{HW|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
In {{HW}}, the Raft appears as an [[Item Card]] in [[Adventure Mode]]. It can be used to cross water from docks, removing locks on certain adjacent squares. In the {{TP|-}} Downloadable Content pack, the [[8-Bit Power Bracelet]] can be unlocked in the Twilight Map. It features the [[Power Bracelet]] paired with the Raft.
{{Noncanon|End}}
